data.features: 272 dimensions; frozen float32 cache converted to float64 before masking/scaling
data.neutral_preprocessing: Eight EEG channels, packet counter excluded; full-record 50 Hz notch Q=30 then zero-phase 0.5-55 Hz bandpass; no within-window z-score; all legacy feature/power multipliers set to 1; FFT 4096

learner.feature_mask: Current training-window std(ddof=0) > 1e-8; reject nonfinite input and no retained feature
learner.scaler: StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True), fit on current training windows only
learner.regularization: L2; l1_ratio=0.0 in sklearn >=1.8, penalty=l2 in earlier versions
learner.tuning: None. Participant-disjoint audit is fixed-learner LOSO, not nested hyperparameter search.
learner.training_row_order: Ascending global window index for every strategy
learner.convergence: ConvergenceWarning is a failed fit, never a completed checkpoint

splits.random_window_88_12: Within participant-task, StratifiedShuffleSplit(n_splits=2, test_size=0.12, random_state=seed), stratified by binary window label; training is the complement. All four recordings must appear in both partitions; fail rather than resample if coverage is missing.
splits.random_window_50_50: Same as random_window_88_12, but test_size=0.50. Separate two-draw splitter for each seed. Approximately, not exactly, matches two-fold recording holdout in window count.
splits.recording_disjoint: Within participant and task, shuffle the two recording IDs of each class using numpy default_rng(seed), in class order 0 then 1. Fold j tests the j-th recording from each shuffled class; the remaining two recordings train.
splits.participant_disjoint: Within-task LOSO: all recordings from other participants train; all four recordings of the held-out participant test; one deterministic fit per held-out participant.
splits.intentional_leakage: Random-window train/test row indices are disjoint but share recordings and overlapping raw samples. These are deliberately leaky comparators for generalization to unseen recordings.

evaluation.recording_probability: For test windows only, clip each class probability to [1e-12,1], exponentiate the mean log probability within each test recording, then normalize across classes. Argmax ties choose class 0.
evaluation.recording_disjoint: Pool the two complementary OOF folds within each seed to four recordings, calculate metrics, then average the five seed metrics within each participant.
evaluation.random_window: Calculate four-recording metrics separately for each draw; average ten draw metrics within each participant, not their probabilities or decisions.
evaluation.participant_disjoint: Calculate metrics on the four held-out recordings for each participant.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Mean across participants of within-participant recording balanced accuracy; seeds/draws/recordings are not independent inferential replicates.
evaluation.definitions: Binary metrics use class 1 as positive. Undefined precision is NaN; average finite values and retain valid counts. The accompanying verify.py implements the recorded definitions.

statistics.bootstrap: Participant cluster percentile 95% CI, numpy quantile(method=linear); one task-specific participant-resampling index matrix shared by all strategies, endpoints and contrasts; paired differences resampled intact.
statistics.seed_algorithm: First 8 bytes of SHA256(namespace + | + task), little-endian integer, numpy default_rng PCG64
statistics.test: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, Pratt zero handling, normal approximation, no continuity correction; round participant differences to 12 decimal places before ranking; all-zero statistic=0 and p=1.
statistics.multiplicity: Six primary contrasts and six fraction-sensitivity contrasts form separate BH families. All twelve also form a combined sensitivity family. These families are separate from the primary 14-method analysis.
statistics.sign_flip_sensitivity: Exact two-sided enumeration over nonzero participant differences; zeros retain zero weight, all-zero p=1; use paired-sum statistic, include equality with tolerance 1e-12. Report BH within each six-contrast family and all12 separately. Assumes sign exchangeability, not a proof of model equivalence.
statistics.effect_unit: percentage points for balanced accuracy differences and their intervals

design_status: Exploratory follow-up specified after the observed grouped-split results were known.
